sentences.text:
This petition has been filed seeking the following reliefs:
"(i) Issue a writ in the nature of the mandamus & direct the respondents to acquire the petitioners' land for the Nauradehi National Park as per the provision section 24(2) of Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972 and as per the provision of Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, in the interest of justice.

sentences.text: (ii) Any other relief deems fit may also be granted including cost of litigation."

It is pointed out that in similar circumstances, a coordinate Bench of this Court has considered the prayer made by the petitioner and has passed an order in the case of Kanai Yadav and others vs. The State of M.P. and others (W.P.no.24260 of 2024) dated 06.08.2024.

sentences.text: Learned State counsel submits that prayer appears to be reasonable and can be accepted.

Under these circumstances, this petition is disposed off with a direction that if the petitioner refunds an amount of Rs.15,00,000/- (Fifteen Lakhs) as per his contention within a period of one month from today to the State authorities and thereafter files an application in terms of the relevant provisions of the Act of 2013, then the authorities are directed to dwell upon the same and take effective steps to decide the application expeditiously.
With the aforesaid observations, the writ petition stands disposed off.
